scope.coverage: Every historical YAML body plus vocabulary/existing docs; hand-authored semantic mappings to public operating contracts.

evidence: Source-derived, not a fresh browser revalidation. Historical filenames and source hashes are provenance only. Original script steps, selectors, eval bodies, fictional content, world payloads and screenshot recipes remain under reference-examples/, not this index.

classifications.unique: Contributes at least one distinct operation, prerequisite, native control/state or boundary; not necessarily the sole historical occurrence.
classifications.redundant: Reuses documented contracts or a composite/smoke/example story; any particular locator/assertion is retained separately.
classifications.regression: Contains deliberate invariants, errors, empty states, persistence/reset, gating or presentation assertions; these are expectations, not an executed pass.
